# Acriotech

> Enterprise software, AI, cloud and automation engineering.

Acriotech is an enterprise software engineering company in Bhavnagar, Gujarat, India. We design, engineer and evolve enterprise software, AI platforms and cloud infrastructure for mid-market and enterprise organisations worldwide.

## Key resources

- [Enterprise Software Development](https://acriotech.com/solutions/enterprise-software): Bespoke, mission-critical applications engineered for stability, security and scale.
- [AI & Intelligent Automation](https://acriotech.com/solutions/ai-intelligent-automation): Enterprise AI and intelligent automation with strict operational bounds.
- [Business Process Automation](https://acriotech.com/solutions/business-process-automation): Automation platforms that make enterprise workflows reliable and auditable.
- [Cloud Infrastructure](https://acriotech.com/solutions/cloud-infrastructure): Resilient, high-availability cloud environments for zero downtime and global scale.
- [Legacy System Modernization](https://acriotech.com/solutions/legacy-system-modernization): Safe, zero-downtime legacy migration and modernization.
- [Data Analytics](https://acriotech.com/solutions/data-analytics): Data engineering, analytics pipelines and business intelligence.
- [Custom Software Development](https://acriotech.com/solutions/custom-software-development): Bespoke software built for your exact operational reality.
- [Services](https://acriotech.com/services): Consulting, product discovery, UI/UX design, development, cloud, DevOps, QA and support.
- [Case Studies](https://acriotech.com/work/featured-projects): Engineering case studies across banking, logistics, healthcare and cloud.
- [Industries](https://acriotech.com/industries): Manufacturing, healthcare, education, logistics, retail, financial services, hospitality, government and startups.
